price_basis: Yahoo OHLC with auto_adjust=False; Adj Close not used; cash dividends not included in returns
notes: 2021-ONWARD RESEARCH, entries from January 1, 2021 through the latest completed exchange session available at execution. Any eligible trading session may supply an entry when prior-close strategy rules pass; there is no Monday, month, anniversary or October-only restriction. This does not force a trade every day. Maximum 45 TRADING SESSIONS, entry is session one; SL/TP may exit earlier. One position at a time per independent scenario, no same-day reentry. Accounts compound across calendar years; positions carry across year boundaries. Calendar-year returns use marked equity, not reset accounts; the final year may be incomplete. Only pre-entry signals and matured outcomes inform decisions. Request ten years of pre-2021 history from 2011, retain all available requested bars, and disclose actual coverage and sample feasibility. Preserve 20 calibration/10 qualifying walk-forward minimums, positive-edge checks, 30-example training window, raw-R target grid and original pattern stops. Insufficient evidence is not a trade. Use the current source watchlist without AMD or AMZN; this is a retrospective full-period cohort study, not a reconstructed point-in-time historical universe. The inherited loader requires at least 60 pre-January-2021 sessions; later-listed names failing that criterion are excluded from the whole study and listed in universe exclusions, not padded with invented prices. Known later TSX selections retain recorded eligibility dates, not January 2021. Compression/balanced/trend-family signals, empirical targets and labeled fixed-2R controls. Separate USD/CAD accounts, fractional sizing by default, 25% allocation and 1.5% planned equity-risk caps, 15 bps/side, zero commissions/dividend cash; gaps may exceed planned risk. Daily stop-first fills, broker fractional execution unverified, current-universe and development-sample bias; historical hit rates are not forecast probabilities. Open positions remain marked and unclassified as wins/losses. Zero-entry scenarios are not evaluable. Do not sum independent scenarios as a portfolio. Previous October and 2026-YTD outputs remain untouched. No orders or live strategy promotion.
